predecessors.name: Qujialing culture
predecessors.text: the Qujialing country that the Shijiahe 'succeeded': the middle Yangtze of Hubei with the Dongting Lake shore and the Three Gorges

ledger.x: 2500 BCE: the Shijiahe culture succeeds the Qujialing on the middle Yangtze.

certainty.note: A prehistoric culture known from its sites; no frontier is documented and the shape is the researcher's reading of 'the middle Yangtze region'.
